text: Read the email: 'Dear Amy, I am busy on Friday. Could you look after my little brother at home? Thanks! Uncle Wang' Write a short reply to accept.
answer: Dear Uncle Wang, I can look after your brother on Friday. Thanks! Amy

steps: 回信要先称呼，再说同意帮忙的事，最后可以写上自己的名字。

答：Dear Uncle Wang, I can look after your brother on Friday. Thanks! Amy
hint: 先想清楚回信里要有哪几部分。
alternative: 也可以写成 Hi Uncle Wang, sure, I will look after him on Friday. Amy 意思对就可以。

text: Read: 'At Wu Bin's home, his father cooks and his mother cleans. At Lily's home, Lily cooks and her father cleans.' Write one sentence to compare the two families.
answer: At Wu Bin's home his father cooks, but at Lily's home Lily cooks.

steps: 写比较句要用「一处……另一处……」的结构，把相同或不同的地方说清楚。
